items.name: agility-lib
items.title: Agility CMS data layer
items.description: Content Fetch client, a cached getContentItem (Next.js Cache Components) and the Web Studio attribute helpers every Agility component uses.
items.docs: Set AGILITY_GUID and both API keys in .env.local (Settings > API Keys in the Agility Content Manager). getContentItem uses "use cache": set `cacheComponents: true` in next.config.

items.name: agility-pic
items.title: AgilityPic
items.description: A responsive <picture> for Agility images: explicit width and height, 1x/2x sources capped at the asset's width, SVGs untouched, and priority loading for the LCP image.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Opens a page: a headline, a short paragraph and one button, with an image beside the text (left or right).
items.docs: Register Hero in your Agility component index under the reference name "Hero". The model definition is in agility/models/components/Hero.json; create it in your instance if it isn't there yet.
